balls.text: in the air and lands safe between three fielders. Good length just outside off. Clubbed over cover. Beats long off, deep point and cover - all three. Sunrisers finish on 115
good length, on middle. Backs away and flat-bats a shot over Southee's head to long off
slapped over cover. Length ball outside off and he threw the bat to the ball. Falls just short of Shakib
full on middle. Bunts a mistimed shot to long off for a single
good length ball. Hurries onto him, forcing Kaul onto the back foot. Defended to mid on
good length on middle. Backs away, and nudges it to backward point for one
full just outside off, and nudged to wide long on for one
full on middle, and worked off his pads to midwicket. Just one on offer
good length outside off. Skidding through. Wants to poke at it off the back foot. Past the outside edge
gets off the mark first ball
helicopter shot down the ground but Rashid hasn't timed it as well. Mavi went full with the slower ball, and it's been struck to Iyer at long on. Mavi takes his second
slower ball, full and wide outside off. Helicopter wrists but smacks it over cover instead! Slices the shot on purpose
good length, outside off stump. Nudged to point off the back foot. They scramble across for one
full outside off. Pushed to cover point for a single
short and wide. Comfortably cut to deep backward point. Fielder there on the boundary line
good length on middle, and tucked off his waist behind square to the fielder in the deep
this time Samad is done as he mistimes a punchy shot in the air. Length ball angling in, and the shot comes off the bat's top half. Gill keeps his eyes on the ball and takes a catch with ease
good length on off, and nudged to midwicket. Nobody there so Southee has to give the ball a chase himself
ruins Chakravarthy's spell! Full, outside off. Turning in. Samad clears the front leg and thumps it over cow corner for six
just over long on! Samad is a powerful man. Chakravarthy goes full outside off, and Samad smacks that with the turn. Iyer just a spectator this time
good length outside off. Slapped in front of cover, but Morgan's dive stops a single, perhaps even two
length ball skidding in. Nudged off his pads to midwicket. Nobody there, apart from the fielder on the boundary line
length ball, turning in sharply. Flicked to wide long on for one. Rashid says no to the double
Iyer at long on takes Holder's wicket. Not as full as Holder thought. Stretches forward to hit a big one, but the ball goes into orbit. Lapped up by the young fielder
full outside off. Pushed past cover point and Narine finishes with 0/12 at an economy of 3.
good length outside off. Turning in. Fended to the off side
good length just outside off. Skidding through. Holder wants to poke at it. Past the bat to DK
good length, on off. Punched off the back foot to the bowler
full on middle. Wants to tuck it leg side but leading edge takes it to off
full on middle. Defended to the leg side. Morgan is at short midwicket
with disdain! Samad won't let Chakravarthy have such a good economy rate. Full outside off. Overpitched, and smacked over long off. Long levers, as they say
length ball outside off. Guided to short third man
good length ball skidding through. Looks to fend off the back foot, but it takes an inside edge to square leg for a single

lbw appeal but not given. Good length just outside off and turning in. Holder looks to play the paddle sweep after coming across to the off side. It hits Holder's pad instead and rolls away to short fine leg. Umpire says its legbye, and KKR review thereafter. Looks like the ball is hitting his front leg, near the thigh. Impact is in front of off. Does ball-tracking say out? Ball-tracking says NOT OUT! Too high, going over middle stump. Knight Riders lose their review.

taken in the deep! Not full enough for the slog. Garg looks to drag this towards deep midwicket, but it doesn't have the distance either. Tripathi runs around the boundary on the longer side, and pockets another catch. Garg out for a useful 21, and you think the innings situation dictated his pace today.
good length on off, and nudged off the pads to midwicket
full just outside off stump. Presses forward and blocks it back to Sunny
short ball cut to the deep for one
tighter line on middle, defended back to the bowler
flatter on off, cuts to the man at point, no run there
length delivery, on off stump, mistimes the drive towards long-on
tad wide outside off, rocks back and cuts to deep cover for a single
length ball angling in from around the stumps. Played to wide long on for a single
overpitched on middle. He muscles a shot down the ground after coming down the track. But mistimed. Long on cleans up
driven to long on for a single
full on off, and he smothers a drive back to the bowler
deposited! Dances down the ground and picks this full ball outside off beautifully. Hammered to cow corner
good length outside off. Goes deep in his crease and then drives off the back foot to extra cover, where Mavi is fielding
length ball on off. Extra bounce, chest high. Paddled to short fine leg, but can't pinch a run
good length outside off. Skidding through. Punched to long on once again
whipped off his waist to deep midwicket. Length ball, turning into him
good length on a stump to stump line. Clipped off the back foot to deep backward square leg
full outside off. Turning in. Fended off the front foot. Soft hands
good length ball outside off. Struck back past Chakravarthy to long on for a single
good length ball angling in from around the stumps. Punched to long on off the back foot for a simple one
length ball just outside off again. Stays on the back foot and bunts it to backward point for a single
good length, outside off. Rocks back and firmly punches. Morgan at cover behind it
full outside off. Defended away to cover
around the tumps. Full on middle, and skidding through. He tries to defend, but it goes between bat and body, and hits the back leg. LBW appeal turned down since this was going to go down leg
straight forward! Full outside off. Sharma comes down the wicket to hoick it over the leg side. But the ball skids straight through instead of turning in. Past the edge, DK does the rest.
uppish but he manages to bunt this down to long-on. The innings is in need of a push
full ball drifting into middle and leg, turned to deep midwicket
eased down to long-off
pushed wide of short cover for a quick single
can't beat the infield, hit straight to cover
punched down to long-on
shortish on middle and leg, worked to deep square
nudges it down to fine leg
Oh, one, two, three and pops out! This one was lobbed back off the inside edge, he had three goes at that but couldn't hold on.
works it down to long-on as they jog the single
fired full on leg, tucked to short midwicket
punched down to long-on
punched into the gap at point
nice flight, driven to long-off
struck on the pad as this keeps drifting in, but the angle would've taken it down perhaps.
gets well forward and defends to point
tucked down to long leg
this one spins away off a length on off, defended back
uppish, but down to long-off

have they got him with a direct hit? Top work from Shakib.  Williamson nudged it to the leg side, took off for a run, Shakib instinctively moved across, picked the ball and fired the throw at the bowler's end in one motion and he has caught Williamson short of the crease.
drifting into middle and leg, worked into the gap between deep midwicket and long-on
nice flight, lands it on off, pushed to short cover
taps it gently into the off side as they scamper a single
lunges forward and defends back
runs it past short third and gets a fourth boundary. Ah, deft touch this time. All he had to do was pick that gap to the either side of short third.  18 off the over
scorching drive and that's blazed through to the cover boundary! Made that into a half-volley as he stepped out, what nimble feet
flayed down to Shakib at deep backward point, two more
slower length ball outside off, he makes room and punches this into the gap between cover and point. Williamson held his shape and then gave it a crack
down the track as he crashes this on the up. but Shakib at point stops it on the bounce.
flayed into the gap at extra cover, this one races away to the fence. Too much width that time
firmly driven but can't pierce extra cover
gets outside the line of off as he defends back
legbreak this time, Garg lunges forward and defends to short third
flatter one drifting into leg stump, tucked past midwicket
once again picks out short fine as he looks to whip this away
drifts down, works it straight to short fine
good leave to a length ball that nips back in from outside off
nice and full on off, he gets well forward and defends.
he's picked out mid-on!  That's a poor shot. He looks to swat this over the infield but got it off the bottom.
spears in an inch-perfect yorker! Roy can only squeeze that back down the pitch. Can't do much about that
beaten by a lovely length ball that nips away off the seam. Roy was looking to use the pace to flay this through point
steps out to wallop this over mid-on but is beaten as he swings early
bunts this down to third man
firm push to cover
slower one on off, looks to work it to the leg side but ends up pushing it back to Southee
drilled to mid-off
steps out and whips this through midwicket, that's a delightful stroke! Strong wrists and superb placement
steps out to mow that into the leg side but gets a thick inside edge that flies past leg stump.
full and swinging away, driven to mid-off
defended solidly to cover, tight over.
mistimed back down to Mavi again
steered down to third man
square driven straight to backward point
right on top of the bounce as he pushes it down to mid-on for a quick single
mistimes an attempted drive back to the bowler off the inner part of the bat
nice little push past the bowler, they'll get a third too because both mid-off and mid-on collided. Shoddy stuff
prods outside the line but gets a thin inside edge onto the pad. Another massive appeal from Southee
full and swinging away from off, defended solidly
full on off, firm push to mid-off

massive appeal and gone! Saha plays for one that nips away but this one comes back in to beat the inside edge and smash him on the pad.  Would've crashed into middle and leg  This would've gone over, as replays confirm. Saha didn't bother reviewing after consulting with Roy.
ah, nearly popped that to mid-on first ball! A misfield allows Roy to get off the mark
short ball, drags a shot from outside off, and pulls it to deep midwicket for four! Kolkata Knight Riders win by six wickets
good length outside off. Cuts it gently through the off-side gap. Scores level
full on middle. Nudged off his pads to deep midwicket. Yes-no-yes-no as they choose not to take the second. But the fielder in the deep fumbles. Could've been two, in hindsight.
full just outside off. Drilled, has four written all over it, but Williamson dives to his right to stop the four
yorker length. Outside off. Pushed to point's right, and calls early for the single
nearly caught! Back of a length, on middle. Smacks the pull super well, and it very nearly goes to Malik at fine leg for a catch
full, on off. Flicks it to wide long on for one
pierces the gap! Fullish, but there's width. DK moves back, and then slaps it hard through point for four!
good length outside off. Punched to cover. No run
length ball just outside off. Fended to the off side
in the air and Saha runs forward to catch. Rolls his fingers over the ball. Back of a length, on middle. Pull attempted, but sliced.
yorker. On off. Dug back to Holder

just safe! And the ball hits the moving camera on the boundary line, and ends up cracking the lens! Pulls this length ball in front of square. Lands inside the boundary, and just beyond Rashid, who was tracking the ball to try and intercept
bit of a slower ball. Full on middle. Swivels and mistimes it to short fine leg
good length outside off and cut behind square to the sweeper fielder on the off side
back of a length outside off. Comfortably pulled to deep square leg for one. Team hundred
good length outside off. Drags a mistimed pull to deep midwicket
full just outside off. A proper flourish of the bat and smacked past Kaul's right to long off for four! Races away
good length on middle.  Rides it down to third man for a single

out for 57! Kaul goes for his toes again. Overpitched on leg stump. Gill flicks, but flicks too well. In the air, and Holder at long on is under it. Has he done enough for this to be a match-winning innings?
overpitched around leg stump. Backs away and digs it away to cover
mistimed but safe. Length ball on middle, and he looks to flick it to cow corner. But through the shot early since its a knuckle ball. In the air, but falls safely in the midwicket region

too much? No just short of long on. Full on middle, and Rana goes for another big shot. This time he doesn't get under the ball as well as he would've liked. One bounce to Holder. Rashid finishes with 1/23
drilled right back! Full on leg. And Rana hammers this googly with the full face of the bat. Past the umpire for another boundary
good length, on off. Goes deep in his crease and pulls to deep midwicket
full on middle. Legbreak nudged to midwicket
full outside off. Turning away this time. Defended back to the bowler
full ball on middle, and turning into leg. Nudged to the gap at midwicket. Easy two for the duo
good length just outside off. Defended off the back foot
good length outside off. Tapped to midwicket for a single
thumped! Length ball, outside off. Easy pickings for Gill. Controlled pull along the ground to deep midwicket for four. Gets his fifty up
good length, on off. Worked off his waist to midwicket
good length outside off. Stays on the back foot to punch to point. Garg chases
Rana continues to struggle against Malik. Length ball from around the stumps, and seams in sharply. Looks to flick it behind square off the back foot, but it is edged onto his body
fullish, on middle. Turning in. Nudged to midwicket with the bat's closed face
fullish, just outside off. Turning in, and fended to Rashid
overpitched on middle. Driven to long off for a single
the audacity! Strike-rate of 35 but Rana goes for the reverse sweep nonetheless. Full on off, and smacked over conventional short third man
good length on off. Turning in. Goes onto the back foot, and punches to long off for one
full on off. The googly turns in. Big stride forward. Defended
defended to the off side. This was 151.1kph!
good length, on off. Rides the bounce and fends off the back foot
length ball outside off from around the stumps. Rana backs away, makes plenty of room...in fact too much room. Can't get bat on ball to cut
length ball angling in, and nudged to square leg for one

Gill is easing the chase out by changing gears. Boundary after boundary off his bat. Comes down the track again to pull a back of a length ball. Mistimed this time, but in the vacant area around deep midwicket
uses the pace so well. Full on his toes, and flicked comfortably to deep backward square leg for four more
back of a length, on off. Mistimes the pull to deep midwicket
another length ball, and another pull in front of square! Comes down the track again and gets enough power to beat the diving midwicket fielder
full on leg, and flicked to fine leg. Fielder has to run around, and successfully stops the second
length ball angling into him. Moves to the leg side and pulls to deep backward square
pulled in front of square but it zips off the grass for four more! Good length outside off. Skips down the ground and controls a shot to the right of long on
good length outside off. Opens the bat's face and nudges it to third man for a single
team fifty as Gill uses his feet to Rashid. Comes down the ground and flicks it over midwicket. Just inside the boundary line!
full just outside off. Pushed to mid off's right
full on off. Turning away and nudged to short third man for a single
length ball on off. Stays low while angling across. Looks to sweep, but misses. Hits the front leg, but this would've missed off stump
full, and swept to deep backward square leg
full on off. Tries to reverse sweep. Misse! Very close to off stump
firm push but can't beat short cover. Pressure building.
plays the delicate dab down to third man
full and angling into middle and leg, turned to midwicket
punched to sweeper point
looks to upper cut but lets it go in the end anticipating it to be called a wide, but the umpire signals one bouncer for the over.
no room as he steps out to slap this through point, finds the fielder as he mistimes.
right into the blockhole, Rana manages to dig it out. Another mighty impressive over from young Malik
bangs it in short but slips it way down leg, another wide
arches back to ramp it up and over the keeper but this kept coming back in, beaten!
missed out on a genuine boundary ball. This was short and wide, asking to be hit. Rana looked to go up and over point
beats him with one that nips away! Rana is squared up as he looks to defend. 144.8kph
what a ripper! Rana is playing for a short ball but he ends up spraying this full outside off, Rana pushes at it and is beaten. 147KPH
slips this short ball down leg, wide called.
beaten for pace as Rana slashes and misses. Bowled at 141kph
right on top of the bounce as he defends to the off side
lucky to get away with that leg-stump half-volley as Gill flicks straight to midwicket
bunts this down to third man
whips this down to deep square
bunts this to point
veers in a full ball from outside off, Gill gets this off a thick inside edge towards midwicket
edged but stopped superbly courtesy a sliding stop at short third by Siddarth Kaul, saved four runs
gets well forward and smothers this
he's cramped for room but looks to take him on with the pull and ends up hitting it to midwicket. This wasn't all that short for him to play the stroke.
googly that he taps into the off side, didn't seem like he picked it
gets well forward and defends back this skiddy length ball
struck on the pad but Tripathi was well outside off as he paddled fine
steps out, Bhuvi bangs one in, Gill defends into the off side. Sent back by Tripathi this time
gets well forward and defends off a thick inside edge onto the pad
lovely timing and placement, deep point thought he had a chance but apparently not. This sped away between backward point and short third. Opened the bat face to pick the gap
defends this to cover, sends Tripathi back as Garg fires in a direct hit at the bowler's end
steps out and punches to wide mid-off for a quick single
uppish and though point. Crisply hit on the up with an opened bat face. Beat Rashid Khan's dive
edged and it races past short third. Streaky boundary. Holder had him pushing at that, got the shape away and induced the edge, only to see it go for four.
length ball that angles in and holds its line outside off, left alone

Williamson takes a tumbling catch running across to his left from mid-off. Frustration gets the better of Venkatesh Iyer! Kooked to hoick this up and over, but ddn't get any power or timing. Williamson had to also contend with the cables of the spidercam.
chopped into the off side, this one nipped back in a long way to hit him high on the bat, may have taken the glove too.
just short of deep square as Samad dives forward for the catch! Iyer hustled for pace and bounce as he fetches this pull from outside off.
angles this down leg, off the pad to Saha, who half-stops
tapped down the ground for a quick single,
cuts hard, the point fielder parries it wide of his finger tips into the off side, two more
tucks himk up with a short ball angling in from around the wicket, this one bowled at 146.8kph, Iyer hops back and defends
half-stop at short fine takes pace off that nudge off his hip
just wide of midwicket!  Malik comes back well with a 141.5kph short ball, Gill doesn't get hold of the pull
crashed away through point! Nervy first ball outside off, too short as well.
beaten as he pushes at this away-going delivery with an angled bat.
looks to force this back down the ground but can't generate any power, finds mid-on
right on top of the bounce as he pushes it into the off side
steps out and works this length ball to mid-on
beaten as he pokes at this away-going length delivery, lovely delivery
errs a hint in line by bowling this on middle and leg, Iyer whips this into the gap at deep midwicket
steps out and pulls this into the gap at deep square leg
goes full on off from wide of the crease, Gill pushes it into the off side with soft hands
steps out and punches this back down the pitch

nearly popped that to short cover, oh Priyam Garg!  Holder gets it to shape away as he goes full from wide of the crease, Gill gets a leading edge, may have just about carried. Garg dived fully forward but couldn't get his fingers underneath the ball.
what a lovely drive down the ground! Steps out and whips this full delivery back down the ground to beat Holder's boot.
whips this to deep square leg
covers the line and negates the swing by taking a step outside the crease, solidly defended
sees him advance and shortens his length, bunts it to point
swing for Bhuvi, lovely shape away, left alone
gets a leading edge but safe, rolls wide of point and they scamper a run
driven to sweeper cover this time as they jog the single
full and swinging away from outside off, left alone
